selection: User selected these four states for geographic coverage before any state results were calculated. Retain every selected state regardless of results.
display_selection: First 50 paired draw IDs, without outcome or appearance selection. Summaries use all 5000.
rule: Frozen national pre-pandemic threshold 1.7 times each evaluated location’s September mean (weeks36–39), first crossing after week39; comparator fixed national week47. No state-specific tuning.
state_draws: Replay each selected state component of the existing 2022/23 national posterior: same cached state fit, same posterior seed plus original model-list index, same 5000 timing shifts and VE parameter pairs. Optimize separately within each state/draw.
scientific_status: Out-of-period evaluation of a frozen rule with retrospective full-season latent curves. Not an as-of-data backtest or a geographic holdout.
